Thank you for this HuffPost
"#MeToo: The Inside Story Of How Vikas Bahl Was Exonerated By His Own Company. A HuffPost India investigation finds multiple flaws with Phantom Film’s Internal Complaints Committee, including if the committee should have been set up at all."

RTI reveals that the Government dissolved the #MeToo Panel.

Why am I not surprised 😂😂😂

https://t.co/fHI9aekdP4

@vijayshankarrr Dear Mr Shan Vijay
Please learn the difference between manhandling, sexual assault and the accusations of molestation, assault and rape that came up during the #MeToo movement and how none of us who spoke the truth got justice. Why didnt men like you speak for us, Sir? Afraid?

Its been almost a year since October 2018 and the second wave of #MeToo in India.
However these messages haven’t stopped since then.

The absolute denial that our family systems are in that molestation could happen by a relative is astounding. https://t.co/p1ruhzQMd8

Fact remains -
all the men named have been successfully whitewashed.
The women who outed their molesters always have the #MeToo movement mentioned in their articles. Zilch for the men.
MJ Akbar, And until recently Kuldeep Sengar are examples.

Similarly - the #MeToo movement was catharsis for us. Us women and some men were finally free of the shackles that society weighed down on us. 
I was 100% sure it would have no effect on Vairamuthu’s work. 
And that doesn’t mean #MeToo is a failure.

The #MeToo Movement has started the conversation and lasting change will take time, as disappointing as recent developments may be.
The point is to keep the conversation alive.

🙏

A ‘Pindadaan’ to signify the death of the #MeToo campaign?!

I wish they had seen how normal sexual assault and violence was and had offered a Pindadaan for the death of rapists, rape, sexual assault and violence.

NO religious organization has done that, has it? 😂
